content:
Onam Games (Onakalikal)

Time: 11:30 AM - 01:30 PM

Venue: College Main Ground

Coordinator: Sports Committee

Traditional Onam sports and fun recreational games celebrating unity, strength, and joy.

Games List

Vadamvali (Tug of War)

Time: 11:30 AM - 12:00 PM

Venue: Main Ground

Rules: Teams of 8 participants. Inter-department elimination rounds.

Uriyadi (Pot Breaking)

Time: 12:00 PM - 12:20 PM

Venue: Central Courtyard

Rules: Blindfolded participant must break the swinging clay pot with a bamboo stick.

Chaakkil Chaattam (Sack Race)

Time: 12:20 PM - 12:35 PM

Venue: Main Track

Rules: Hop to the finish line inside a jute gunny sack.

Lemon and Spoon Race

Time: 12:35 PM - 12:50 PM

Venue: Courtyard Walkway

Rules: Balance a lemon on a spoon held with teeth while racing to the finish line.

Sundariykku Pottuthodal (Bindi on Bride)

Time: 12:50 PM - 01:05 PM

Venue: Auditorium Porch

Rules: Blindfolded participant must stick a bindi accurately on the target drawing.

Kasera Kali (Musical Chairs)

Time: 01:05 PM - 01:30 PM

Venue: Courtyard Stage

Rules: Walk around chairs and grab a seat when the traditional music stops.
